judged_text: Salesforce is the only refreshed app not routed through refreshOAuthTokens — it refreshes directly against login.salesforce.com even when CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is configured. A parallel refresh path contradicts the feature's own architecture: self-hosters configuring sync still get direct Salesforce calls from the child using parent-shared refresh tokens, and credential rotation performed on the parent never propagates to salesforce credentials.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path is a direct `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` with no use of the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper or any conditional on `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`/`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED`. Other integrations in this diff were explicitly routed through `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` to support the sync endpoint. So when sync is configured, Salesforce will still refresh against Salesforce directly, contradicting the newly introduced sync architecture.
